how_to_fill: status = done | na | skipped. 'na' needs a note saying why. 'skipped' or blank makes the run NOT FULL. Items for the other engine or profile are ignored.

items.check: Rules read from the doc tab (or RULES_v05_baseline.md) in this chat, not from memory notes
Profile and versions stated at the top of the reply
Canary: every tool failure, partial pull or workaround flagged at the very top
FLOW pulled for every game on this run, source game labelled
FLOW pulled for every game given deep review (or FLOW SKIPPED - TIME PRIORITY printed)
Consensus pulled from 5 or more books, DSB left out, compared only at identical numbers
Inactives / starters checked for EVERY game at about T-85/T-90, source named
QB status resolved or LINEUP UNRESOLVED printed for every game; OL SHOCK checked
Weather / roof checked for every outdoor game; WIND FLAG applied
CONSENSUS DIVERGENCE checked on every candidate
HOOK candidates priced with win/push/loss at DSB's number; 3.0 floor and EV > 0 applied
DERIV-LAG row logged for the 20-board count (no fire)
One selection per game; ticket cap 3 per window
Time lock respected: nothing after T-12 (1H) / Q3 -4 (2H); late items TIME-BLOCKED
Run finished before kickoff (1H) / 3Q kickoff (2H); nothing recommended in-play
Robinhood ladder pulled for every game (reference under v05; price test with +2c fee under current)
Execution venue matches the profile (v05: DSB only; current: DSB or Robinhood, better EV first)
CLEAR LEAN test printed for every game run: three inputs, split, hard-counter check
A MATCHUP LEAN line for every game examined, citing its FLOW rows
No lean or fire on a total rests on FLOW
Halftime confirmed on the scoreboard; 2H kickoff receiver logged
Pregame handoff loaded: HANDOFF VERIFIED / INCOMPLETE / UNAVAILABLE printed; open full-game tickets flagged
1H drive chart pulled with play text; drive count and scoring reconciled to the linescore
2H consensus from OT-inclusive books; live full-game line pulled for the implied 2H line
Convergence screen: every half-point touching 3 or 7 evaluated as a HOOK CANDIDATE
Blowout (17+), 45+ first half, wind, QB change and opener gates each checked
FLOW-TOTAL (SHADOW) line printed (or 'no view')
HOOK-through-divergence clause checked: DSB strictly beats every book, else shadow
Slate sweep row printed for every game with FLAGGED / STATIC
Watchlist of at most four deep reviews; lightweight screen line for every other game
Every fire, lean, shadow and conditional written to the log with number, price, venue, timestamp
OWED list printed: grades due, closes due, unconfirmed placements
Previous board's grades and closing lines pulled before this run (or listed as still owed)
Sizing stated in units ($300 to win); any upsizing declared before the price
RECOMMENDED section printed at the end (bets with venue, number, price, size - or 'none')
